FN-W4IGE9E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 120
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Rep Mike Shaw
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 120 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of local boards of
education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in 1) the price paid for
installation, on property owned by the local board of education, of items purchased through
certain cooperative purchase agreements currently exempt from competitive bid laws, and 2) the
cost of installation paid by these boards otherwise obtained from competitive bid.
